periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal facial midline, angled toward the lower outer quadrant.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with an elongated vertical-to-horizontal ratio of approximately 1.6:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced tapering at the inferior boundary, creating a teardrop effect relative to the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Deep U-shaped posterior curve with a smooth transition into the white dorsal fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Consistent thickness across the transverse axis, comprising approximately 20-25% of the visible torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation distance approximately equivalent to three times the width of a single ear base.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brownish-grey soil staining or fur discoloration on the posterior hindquarters and lower flank compared to the bright white dorsal region.
